description: Hand-maintained inputs for scripts/deps-register.mjs and scripts/deps-check.mjs (ADR-0073). Keys are package names, name@version, or a name prefix ending in *. status: approved, reviewed (conditional licence reviewed), or a string starting with pending (allowed, reported on every check, never for prohibited licences); preferred licences need no status. Anything else non-preferred fails the check.

@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono.obligations: Keep the OFL text with redistributed font files.
@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono.notes: SIL OFL 1.1, approved by the coordinator (docs/dependencies.md). Keep node_modules/@fontsource/*/LICENSE when redistributing; no font CDN.

@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans.obligations: Keep the OFL text with redistributed font files.
@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans.notes: SIL OFL 1.1, approved by the coordinator (docs/dependencies.md). Keep node_modules/@fontsource/*/LICENSE when redistributing; no font CDN.

caniuse-lite.obligations: CC-BY-4.0 attribution if the data is distributed; build-time data only.
caniuse-lite.notes: Not previously listed in docs/dependencies.md (transitive of browserslist).

elkjs.obligations: EPL-2.0: used unmodified; the worker script is loaded by URL on demand.
elkjs.notes: Package metadata says EPL-2.0 (docs/dependencies.md also records the GPL-3.0-or-later alternative; EPL-2.0 is the one used).

lightningcss*.status: pending review: conditional MPL-2.0, dev-only build tool (Tailwind/Vite)
lightningcss*.obligations: MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft; used unmodified as a build tool, not distributed in the product bundle. Compliance review not yet recorded.
lightningcss*.notes: Not previously listed in docs/dependencies.md (transitive of @tailwindcss/vite).

replicad-opencascadejs.obligations: LGPL-2.1 with the OCCT exception: keep the WASM binary a separate replaceable file, ship the licence text and OCCT notice (apps/workspace/public/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt), state use of Open CASCADE Technology, point to the exact source, allow reverse engineering for debugging the library.
replicad-opencascadejs.notes: Whether LGPL-2.1 suits the product is the owner decision in ADR-0021. Not approved by this register.

webgl-constants.status: pending review: no licence field in package metadata
webgl-constants.notes: package.json and the lockfile have no licence field; the package ships a LICENSE file with MIT text (verified in node_modules, copyright Tim van Scherpenzeel). Transitive of @react-three/drei via detect-gpu. Not approved by this register; the coordinator should confirm or ask upstream to add the field.
webgl-constants.obligations: Keep the MIT notice if bundled.
